title: tragacantha heratensis
intro: Tragacantha heratensis, commonly known as Herat milk thistle, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, native to Afghanistan. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of liver and gallbladder disorders, and is also used to alleviate inflammation and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha heratensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha heratensis include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
